business_summary: GuangDong HongTeo Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, processing, and sale of aluminum alloy precision die castings, auto parts, key parts and components of automotive dual clutch transmission (DCT), and communication parts in China and internationally. The company offers battery tray assembly, electrical control box housing, battery box front panel, rear panel of battery box, gearbox housing, electrical control box housing, casing, motor housing inner shell, motor housing inner shell, and PIM housing. It also provides flywheel housing, trapezoidal frame plate, timing gear housing, high-pressure die-cast pipe bend, nano2020 ladder frame, oil pan, lower cylinder, head and oil filter cooler, camshaft housing assembly, and oil filter cooling housing. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of financial technology and environmental protection services, as well as industrial investment activities. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Paisheng Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd and changed its name to GuangDong HongTeo Technology Co.,Ltd. in November 2024. GuangDong HongTeo Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Zhaoqing, China.
